name: @local/dsh-session-keeper
description: Crash recovery and keep-alive for active Harness sessions: resumes interrupted turns after a crash, once, behind a proxy readiness gate.

meta.title: Session Keeper
meta.description: Recovers sessions whose turn was interrupted by a crash, power loss, or kill. Scans stored session logs for an unbalanced final turn, resumes exactly once through the harness's own agent path, and quarantines sessions that keep crashing the host.
